scope_note: This is bounded to the tested current and historical groups of healthy young adults, nocturnal exposure patterns and phase-delay portion of the response curve. It does not establish the same direction or magnitude for daytime light, other spectra, clinical populations or all individuals.
statement: Across the tested nocturnal bright-light exposure groups, circadian phase-delay shifts were significantly greater than in dim-light control conditions.
statement_zh: 在該研究納入的夜間亮光暴露組中，晝夜節律相位延遲均顯著大於微光控制條件。
